currentCard.explanation: Позвоночник состоит из позвонков и межпозвоночных дисков. Этот подвижный столб поддерживает голову, шею и тело и защищает спинной мозг.

literal.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 7.3 L31 identifies a sequence of vertebrae as the spinal column; L32/L35–36 include adult sacrum/coccyx derived by fusion. «Из каких костей в основном» correctly asks the bone class and accommodates those fused adult elements. Discs are not competing bones.7.4 L30/L41 place ribs in thoracic cage attached posteriorly to thoracic vertebrae, rather than making ribs the spine;8.2 L30 places phalanges/carpals in the hand. Four parallel real bone groups make exactly key3 independently true, without relying on frozen index.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Позвоночник состоит из позвонков и межпозвоночных дисков. Этот подвижный столб поддерживает голову, шею и тело и защищает спинной мозг.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 7.3 L31 explicitly says vertebrae plus intervertebral discs form the flexible column, support head/neck/body and protect the spinal cord; L102/L105–106 explain discs and motion. The two Russian sentences faithfully summarize these linked facts. No statement that discs are bones or that every vertebral pair has a disc is made. Two sentences directly naming the key entity, below70 words.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Рёбра образуют грудную клетку и сзади соединяются с грудными позвонками.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 7.4 L30–31 explicitly says ribs form the thoracic cage and anchor posteriorly to12 thoracic vertebrae; L41 describes posterior articulations. The note retains posterior location and supplies a useful own-rib fact, not a false claim that ribs constitute the vertebral column.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Фаланги — кости пальцев; в каждой кисти их четырнадцать.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 8.2 L30 explicitly says fingers/thumb contain14 phalanx bones per hand. The note correctly identifies phalanges as finger bones and limits14 to each кисть, not both hands or a single finger. Full introductory hand-bone paragraph is present within actual returned context; later unreturned section is not claimed read.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Восемь костей запястья образуют основание кисти.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 8.2 L30 explicitly gives eight carpal bones at the base of the hand; L55–57 show location and arrangement. The note accurately teaches both count and location of its own carpal option, without confusing carpals with finger phalanges or spinal bones.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: У взрослого человека к 24 позвонкам добавляются крестец и копчик, образованные сросшимися позвонками.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 7.3 L32/L35–36 explicitly give the typical adult24 vertebrae plus sacrum/coccyx formed from fused vertebrae; L93/L98 explain fusion. This adds adult count and developmental origin beyond the prompt/key «позвонки». It does not say the entire adult spine has only24 bones or deny fused elements. Adult description is read as typical anatomy, with the source age-of-fusion context retained.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Рёбра образуют грудную клетку и сзади соединяются с грудными позвонками.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Из каких костей ...? — Из рёбер» is grammatically complete, with из+genitive plural like every option.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Ribs belong to the axial trunk skeleton and physically attach to vertebrae, making a genuine anatomical confusion.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 7.4 L30/L41 place ribs in the thoracic cage anchored to vertebrae;7.3 L31 identifies the column itself as vertebrae/discs. Rib attachment does not make ribs the primary column bones.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The own-rib note accurately teaches thoracic-cage membership and posterior thoracic-vertebra connection (7.4 L30–31/L41), a useful standalone fact.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Фаланги — кости пальцев; в каждой кисти их четырнадцать.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Из каких костей ...? — Из фаланг» is grammatical; consistent preposition/case and answer-label pattern.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A real named class of small repeated skeletal bones; a player unfamiliar with anatomical labels can plausibly confuse the group.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 8.2 L30 places phalanges in fingers/thumb, while7.3 L31 defines the spine’s vertebrae. Phalanges are not the spine bones.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: 8.2 L30 directly supports finger bones and14 per hand; the count is precisely qualified «в каждой кисти», not a misleading whole-body number.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Восемь костей запястья образуют основание кисти.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Из каких костей ...? — Из костей запястья» is grammatical; added descriptor is the standard name of this bone group, not a key-only form.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A real anatomical bone group, comparable to ribs/phalanges/vertebrae; no impossible object or joke option.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 8.2 L30/L56 places carpals in the wrist/hand base;7.3 L31 defines vertebrae for the spine. Thus no second key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Eight and base-of-hand location are explicit in8.2 L30, with full surrounding carpal paragraphL56, useful facts about the option itself.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: У взрослого человека к 24 позвонкам добавляются крестец и копчик, образованные сросшимися позвонками.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Из каких костей ...? — Из позвонков» is natural Russian, parallel to the other из+genitive plural choices.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Common adult term appears among real bone classes; semantic relation in позвоночник/позвонки is normal subject language, not an artificial format or agreement giveaway.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 7.3 L31–36 independently support vertebrae as the primary bones, with fused sacrum/coccyx included through origin. Intervertebral discs in explanation are connective structures, not a second answer to a bone question.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: 7.3 L32/L35–36 add24 adult vertebrae plus sacrum/coccyx and their fusion origin, beyond prompt/key. Explanation does not merely supply that count; the note has concrete additional own-vertebra information.

absoluteLevel.assessment: Spine made of vertebrae is broad adult school/body knowledge. No regional counts, specialist vertebral name or fusion timeline is required to answer. All alternatives are real skeletal bone groups, with ribs a close trunk-skeleton confusion and hand-bone names plausible to an unfamiliar player. Their explanatory notes are shown as learning facts, not prerequisites. EASY is independent of author or prior47 acceptance.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Typical adult24 vertebrae plus sacrum and coccyx formed by fusion.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: Prompt/key only name the bone class; adult count and fusion-derived bones are additional own-vertebra facts directly in7.3 L32/L35–36 (alsoL93/L98).
